nodes.title: Pack voltage at the end of a flight, loaded
nodes.text: 4S pack at 3.4 V/cell under full-throttle load
nodes.basis: 4S 6500 130C late in the flight; same basis as the K09 review section (3.4 V/cell)

nodes.title: Cylinder drag coefficient 1.1
nodes.text: 22 mm tube in the slipstream, Re ~1.3e4 (subcritical)
nodes.basis: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3: Cd 1.0-1.2 for 1e4 < Re < 2e5

nodes.title: Slipstream peak-to-mean dynamic pressure 1.3
nodes.text: A real prop loads its outer half: the tube sees about 1.3 x the mean slipstream dynamic pressure
nodes.basis: typical blade loading peak near 0.75 R; bounds the uniform-disk value from above

nodes.title: Foot frontal area 30 x 30 mm
nodes.text: crushable printed foot on each fin TE tip, near the prop axis
nodes.basis: bounds D5's GER-001 shoe over the 9.6 mm fin TE (subsystems/landing/SPEC.md: 11 x 18 mm cartridge in a sleeve); D5 publishes no frontal area

nodes.title: Sharp-edged strip and ear drag coefficient 1.2
nodes.text: 10 x 3 mm pultruded CF brace broadside to the flow with its 10 mm side along x (depth/height 3.3), and the printed collar ears (blunt prisms)
nodes.basis: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3, and Delany & Sorensen NACA TN 3038: sharp rectangular sections at depth/height 3 have Cd 1.1-1.4 (on the height) at Re 1e3-1e4

nodes.title: ESC on its pad: 8 mm proud of the board, Cd 0.9
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A board in heat-shrink with a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap, on the 1.2 mm PETG pad; frontal = pad height x (pad + ESC), blunt box of length/thickness ~5
nodes.basis: E1 has not published ESC dimensions (PRP-002); typical 45 A BLHeli_S board 5 mm thick + heat-shrink and strap; Hoerner ch. 3 blunt box

nodes.title: Cant sense per F4's motor map (k = +1)
nodes.text: the side component of each canted thrust points toward the wing plane and outboard, so each hover wake leans away from the wing and inboard, and each disc's wing-side edge swings aft toward the tube
nodes.basis: subsystems/flight-software/SPEC.md motor table and 'Cant sense' (CL-F4-MOTOR-MAP); D3's fin_detail.mount.cant_sense_UR +1 is the opposite (CR-B4-16)

nodes.title: Shear-layer spreading 0.08
nodes.text: the slipstream edge mixing layer grows 0.08 m per metre downstream on each side
nodes.basis: plane mixing layer vorticity thickness growth ~0.16-0.18 dx at velocity ratio 0 (Brown and Roshko 1974); half toward each side

nodes.title: Pitot error limit 2 %
nodes.text: thrust-dependent airspeed error at the probe tip must stay within 2 % of true airspeed (a constant bias is removed by ARSPD_RATIO; a thrust-dependent one is not)
nodes.basis: B4 choice; ArduPilot airspeed calibration removes only a constant ratio

nodes.title: Vortex-ring onset at 0.28 v_h
nodes.text: vortex-ring state begins at a descent rate of about 0.28 times the hover induced velocity
nodes.basis: Leishman, Principles of Helicopter Aerodynamics 2nd ed., sec. 2.14: VRS boundary from about -0.28 v_h (onset) to -1.0 v_h; conservative lower edge

nodes.title: Pitot boom 80 mm ahead of the pod front at z 0.045 m
nodes.text: plug-in pitot boom on the pod nose, probe along body x, tip 80 mm ahead of the pod front face, 30 mm above the pod base
nodes.basis: B4 placement (CR-B4-05); D2 draws POD-006; the tip x follows pod.x_le_m if the pod moves

nodes.title: Fin effective aspect ratio doubles on the wing
nodes.text: the wing acts as an end plate at the fin root inside the slipstream
nodes.basis: image method for a plate ending on a wall

nodes.note: abstract and a citing review read; full paper not read

nodes.title: APC data transcription check
nodes.equation: Ct' = T / (rho n^2 D^4) ; Cp' = P / (rho n^3 D^5) from the printed N and W ; error = max |Ct'/Ct - 1|, |Cp'/Cp - 1| over rows with Ct, Cp >= 0.02 (4-digit rounding < 0.25 %)

nodes.title: Static operating points, five candidate props
nodes.equation: hover: T_h = k_dl m g / (4 cos cant) -> rpm, P_shaft from Ct, Cp ; FM = T^1.5 / sqrt(2 rho A) / P_shaft ; full throttle: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q/Kt + I0 (E1 constants, hot winding) ; T/W (bus held, no current limit) = 4 T_max cos cant / (k_dl m g) ; rpm limit = K / D_in (APC)

nodes.title: Cruise operating point, five props, all four motors running
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; solve rpm: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta_p = T V / P_shaft ; P_in = (rpm/Kv + I R) I + P_esc (E1 constants, 25 degC winding) ; total = 4 P_in

nodes.title: Hover download on tube, collars, braces, ESC pads, half-fins, feet and wing
nodes.equation: v_i = sqrt(T / 2 rho A) ; v(s) = v_i (1 + s / sqrt(s^2 + R^2)) ; r_s = R / sqrt(v/v_i) ; wake axis along the canted shaft from the hub (cant, sense k) ; item drag = Cd q A for every tube, collar, ear, brace and ESC element inside r_s and outside the motor-can shadow ; fin: 2 Cf q h_w dx over the wetted strip of the half-fin plane (top edge from the station collar to the TE tip) ; base 0.5 q t h_w (t = board x layers) ; foot q A at half speed ; wing: reach = r_s + mix s, gap = z_c - reach - z_surf ; k = 1 + D/T

nodes.title: Cruise drag of the R3 fin hardware (collars, ears, braces, ESC pads)
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; inside the slipstream (r < R about the x-parallel cruise wake) u = V + v (1 + s / sqrt(s^2 + R^2)), else V ; D = sum Cd 0.5 rho u^2 A x 4 stations ; dCD0 = D / (q S), S = b c ; share = D / (m g / (L/D)) ; dP = P_cruise x share

nodes.title: Slipstream edge versus elevons and wing (canted, leaning hover wake)
nodes.equation: hover: inner edge z = z_c(x) - r_s(s) - mix s, wake centre z_c from the hub along the canted shaft ; elevon tip z = c_e sin(delta_max) ; cruise: wake along x, r_s ~ R (lightly loaded) ; gap = edge - surface ; _alt = mirrored spin map (wake leans toward the wing)

nodes.title: Pitot tip x station from the pod nose and the boom
Prop-induced airspeed error at pitot candidates
nodes.equation: v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; four semi-infinite vortex cylinders, gamma = 2 v, each from its canted hub along the resultant of V (+x) and v (canted shaft) ; u = u_axial e + u_radial r_hat (elliptic K, E) ; error = u_x / V ; grid: Simpson N = 100/200/400, wake length 20/40/80 R

nodes.title: Fin side force from swirl and cant, and hover yaw authority
nodes.equation: Gamma_s = Q / (rho v_i pi (R^2 - r_h^2)) ; v_t = Gamma_s / r ; v_n = v_t (normal part) + v_a e_y/e_x (canted wake lean) ; alpha = atan(v_n / v_a) ; dF = a(AR) alpha q dA (Helmbold, AR = 2 h_w / c) ; M_body = sum z dF (about the body x-axis) ; yaw factor = 1 + M_body / Q ; yaw per N of differential thrust = (Q/T) factor + r_arm sin(cant) ; half-fin root moment = F (z_cp - z_root)

nodes.title: Prop spacing and blade-to-tube gap with the canted discs, descent limit, ground effect and tones
nodes.equation: hub moved stack sin(cant) along the thrust side ; disc plane normal n = canted shaft ; blade x over a point (y, z) = x_hub + (n_y dy + n_z dz) / (-n_x) ; gap = x_face - x_blade over the tube and collars inside R ; gap_v = 2 (z_hub - R sqrt(1 - n_z^2)) ; v_h = sqrt(k m g / (8 rho A)) ; V_d,max = 0.28 v_h ; T_IGE/T = 1 / (1 - (R / 4 h)^2) ; M_tip = pi D n / a ; BPF = 2 n

nodes.title: UIUC-measured cross-check of the APC predictions
nodes.equation: static: Ct_UIUC / Ct_APC and Cp_UIUC / Cp_APC at J = 0, top measured rpm ; FM ratio = (Ct ratio)^1.5 / Cp ratio ; cruise: solve Ct_UIUC(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta = T V / P

nodes.title: Unlimited full-throttle rpm on a fresh pack and the output cap that respects the APC limit
nodes.equation: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q(rpm)/Kt + I0, cold winding (lowest R, highest rpm), V = max OCV ; cap: find V_eff giving rpm = 0.98 x 105000/D_in ; duty = V_eff / V_ocv,max ; T/W at the cap = 4 T(rpm_cap) cos cant / (k_dl m g)

nodes.title: Installed thrust with the R3 fin station mock-up and a wing strip
nodes.procedure: Same stand; the printed 7 deg canted mount on a 22 mm tube cut to the R3 end (0.172 m from the chord plane), mount and station collars with their ears, one 10 x 3 mm brace strip to a dummy anchor, an ESC dummy (8 x 28 x 46 mm) on the pad station, a two-layer 0.21 m half-fin with the R3 top edge, and a 0.32 m S5010 wing strip at the right offset; measure the blade-tip gap over the tube by hand first; compare thrust at equal rpm with and without; repeat with the brace and ESC removed, then the fin, then the strip.

nodes.title: Fin side force and yaw moment from swirl and cant
nodes.procedure: Stand with torque cell and the 7 deg canted mount; the half-fin mock-up on its own side-force cell (two load points give the centre of pressure); at hover thrust record reaction torque and fin side force, then with the 0 deg mount. Body-axis yaw factor = 1 + F z_cp / Q.
